modalities.evidence: This dataset contains the EEG data used for the study

output.population: Twenty healthy participants (twelve female, eight male), age 24.6 ± 3.2 years, all right-handed
output.summary: EEG recordings from healthy right-handed adults during tendon vibration, collected to separate the percept of illusory movement from that of sensory stimulation. Subjects sat facing away from the stimulated left arm wearing a wireless EEG cap.
